### Environment
App/Android version, phone model, language, network policy.

### Reproduction
Numbered steps using non-sensitive data.

### Expected and actual behavior
Include whether the problem is repeatable.

### Diagnostics
For upload issues, distinguish record status from Vault status and Wi-Fi from cellular. Never attach private media, tokens or credentials. Security issues follow SECURITY.md.
